Class RegularPro

java.lang.Object
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.card.Card
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.card.ProgrammingCard.ProgrammingCard
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.card.ProgrammingCard.RegularPro
All Implemented Interfaces:
RegisterCard, Cloneable
public class RegularPro extends ProgrammingCard
A standard programming card that performs basic robot actions such as movement, rotation, power-up, and repeating the previous action.

Supports action types: "move", "backup", "turnLeft", "turnRight", "uTurn", "powerUp", and "again".

    • execute

      public void execute(Robot robot, Player player)
      Executes the programming action on the specified robot.

      If the robot is powered down or the board is null, logs an error and aborts. Supported actions:

      • "move": move forward by distance squares
      • "backup": move backward by distance squares
      • "turnLeft": rotate left
      • "turnRight": rotate right
      • "uTurn": rotate 180 degrees
      • "powerUp": grant the player 1 energy
      • "again": repeat the last non-Again register action

      Specified by:
      execute in interface RegisterCard
      Specified by:
      execute in class ProgrammingCard
      Parameters:
      robot - the robot performing the action
      player - the player controlling the robot
